summary: NextSync 0.2.5: Settings now actually opens (two crashes fixed) so folders can be added, Lucide settings-2/info icons, and a monochrome transparent tray icon.
changelog: Fixed the Settings window crashes that kept it closed: SettingsWindow received an AccountRuntime that did not expose the attributes it reads (push_message, push_state, watched_directories, reconfigure, logger), and the legacy config view never copied delete_guard. Both fixed, so you can now open Settings, add sync folders, and actually synchronize.
Settings and About buttons now use the Lucide settings-2 and info icons.

The tray icon is now the monochrome Lucide cloud glyph on a transparent background (cloud-off when no account is configured), rendered as an ARGB pixmap so the tray host shows it identically and never black.
